account: On 15 May 2025 software-engineering students from Karadeniz Technical University were presenting their Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center) to members of parliament. DHA's report describes it as an AI-based earthquake early-warning system. During the presentation, in the TBMM Public Relations building in Ankara, a quake centered in Kulu, Konya, was felt in the capital. DHA gave the magnitude as 5.2. USGS lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some MPs and building staff went outside. The read reports mention no damage or injuries.

ai_role.statement: The system is called yapay zeka tabanlı (AI-based) in DHA's report, on the students' description. None of the read reports explains how it detects quakes, what data it uses, or whether the alert time was logged. The 30-second lead is the statement of student Birkan Yılmaz, a member of the team that built it. DHA carried it and Haberler, Yeni Akit and Yeni Çağ reproduced it. No MP, AFAD or Kandilli comment on the alert was found. Leaving the building was a human response to the notification and to the shaking.

claim_basis: Sources: four independent news reports and one independent dataset. The cited evidence includes no independent study or report and no finding by a regulator or court.

fields.account: On 15 May 2025 software-engineering students from Karadeniz Technical University were presenting their Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center) to members of parliament. DHA's report describes it as an AI-based earthquake early-warning system. During the presentation, in the TBMM Public Relations building in Ankara, a quake centered in Kulu, Konya, was felt in the capital. DHA gave the magnitude as 5.2. USGS lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some MPs and building staff went outside. The read reports mention no damage or injuries.

USGS lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some MPs and building staff went outside. The read reports mention no damage or injuries.
